tools.name: reticle_viewport
tools.description: Pin the DRIVEN or LEASED page (needs `reticle drive`, or `reticle_lease` acquire when there is no CDP provider) to a fixed viewport size so a screenshot baseline is reproducible across machines — the missing piece of CI-stable visual regression, alongside reticle_visual_diff `masks` and a frozen clock (reticle_clock). Set it once before reticle_screenshot / reticle_visual_diff. On a lease it also sets prefers-color-scheme and prefers-reduced-motion; give only those to change the media and keep the size. Returns { applied, width, height, observed } or the no-provider recommendation; `observed` is the size the leased page reports after the resize.

params.name: colorScheme
params.description: prefers-color-scheme for this page: light, dark or no-preference.

params.name: reducedMotion
params.description: prefers-reduced-motion for this page: reduce or no-preference.

params.name: sessionId
params.description: OMIT THIS unless you mean a specific tab — Reticle scopes to your project, prefers the active one, and refuses rather than guesses when ambiguous. Pass an id from reticle_sessions only to target a particular tab. The previous wording ("omit when only ONE session is open") was wrong and cost real turns: with three sessions connected — an app plus two pool leases — resolution is still unambiguous, but that sentence sent the agent off to list and filter sessions by hand before every single call.

tools.name: reticle_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a pixel screenshot of the DRIVEN page (needs `reticle drive`/RETICLE_CDP_URL — the SDK has no screenshotter) and save it as a visual baseline at .reticle/visual/<name>.png. { fullPage } for the whole scroll height, { ref } or { clip:{x,y,width,height} } for one element/region. Returns { saved:true, name, path, bytes } or { ok:false, reason } when no driven browser is attached.

params.name: name
params.description: Baseline name — saved as .reticle/visual/<name>.png. Use the same name in reticle_visual_diff to compare.

params.name: fullPage
params.description: Capture the full scroll height. Default: viewport only.

params.name: ref
params.description: Element ref to screenshot (scopes to element bounding box). Omit for full page.

params.name: clip
params.description: Explicit { x, y, width, height } clip rectangle in page coordinates.

params.name: sessionId
params.description: OMIT THIS unless you mean a specific tab — Reticle scopes to your project, prefers the active one, and refuses rather than guesses when ambiguous. Pass an id from reticle_sessions only to target a particular tab.
